Deleting your account is permanent and your data cannot be recovered.

Expenses you’ve created or participated in will not be deleted. They’ll remain visible to anyone else involved.

To continue, you’ll need to re-enter your password to confirm.

Your password must have at least %1$s characters
Are you sure you want to log out?\nYou’ll need to log back in to access your groups and expenses
Visible only to your contacts and group members.\nEverything is end-to-end encrypted, which means we can’t see your profile — only the people you choose to share it with.
DuckCount is built by the engineers at Lidory
Lidory is a company specializing in software development and cybersecurity. It develops both consumer applications and business software.\n\nPrivacy and cybersecurity are top priorities for us.
Reserve the username your contacts will use to add you.\n\nOnly a fingerprint of it reaches our servers, so we never learn the username itself — only somebody who already knows it can find you.
Choose the new username your contacts will use to add you.\n\nThe one you hold now is released as soon as the new one is reserved, so anybody still looking for the old one will no longer find you.
